name: github-exelearning
description: Open eXeLearning resources stored on GitHub in the official editor and save them back to the repository (github.exelearning.dev).

scripts.fixture: rm -rf test/fixture && git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/ateeducacion/exelearning-style-book.git test/fixture && git -C test/fixture remote remove origin
scripts.dev: APP_ORIGINS=http://localhost:8787 npm run build && wrangler dev --port 8787 --var APP_ORIGIN:http://localhost:8787 --var EDITOR_ORIGIN:http://127.0.0.1:8787
